graph.title: Mini Digger 7246
notes: Revised again using the checker's error list. Pieces on the base p19 now sit only on cells the earlier checks accepted.

Clues from the earlier errors: the clip plates p17/p18 and the hinge-plate finger p20 stick out to the BACK at turn 0. So p17 is turned 180 and shifted 0.7 so its plate lands on the red plate and its clip points to the front. p18 is turned 0 so its clip points to the back. p20 is turned 270 so its finger points toward the bucket (-x).

Grille tiles p2/p3 are no longer above the base. The tiles earlier 'rested on' studless positions and the base seemed to rest on p2/p3, so I moved them into the base's 2x2 opening, lying on the studs of p12 (layer 0 relative to p19). p2 is in the opening column that holds under both guesses at the opening's position. p3 sits in the next column, which assumes the opening is at columns 2-3. If the opening is at columns 1-2, p3 is wrong.
Tile p1 stays on the near rim of the base, where an earlier check accepted it.

Bar p16 now stands on plate p6 (the bar's studs hold the red plates p8/p9 and cone p22). So p16, p6, p8 and p9 are listed as step 4, not the booklet's separate steps 4-6, so each piece rests on something added no later than itself. The clip plates p17/p18 sit on p8/p9 and hold the shovel p14 and jackhammer p7 vertically, outside the body.
Seat p15 is on the rear of the base. Steering stand p13 is on p6 at the front, facing the seat.
Wedge p23 is still the base for hood p21 (confirmed by the earlier checks) and hinge plate p20. p3 is moved off the wedge, because its cell at the wedge's rear end seems to have no stud.

Wheels and tyres: the axle runs front-back at turn 0, and holders p32/p33 are turned 90 so their pins point sideways. Wheel hubs overlap the holder pins by about 0.25 stud, and each tyre is centred on its wheel. The pin height (0.8 plate above the holder's lowest point) is a guess and could still cause 'same space' flags.
Hinge chain: p10 interlocks with the p20 finger and the bucket p11 interlocks with p10's front finger. The finger and tooth heights are guesses.

The checker seems to detect pin, hinge and clip joins from shapes only, not from other_joins. I kept other_joins as documentation. If groups remain disconnected, the likely causes are guessed finger, clip or pin heights and directions.
The minifigure is not in the piece list, so it is not included. Steps 9 and 10 repeat the step 8 pictures, so the underside parts p32/p33/p4/p5 are listed in step 8.

graph_initial.title: Mini Digger 7246
notes: The booklet is small and ambiguous, so many placements are estimates.
Front of the model is the bucket end. p12 is turned 90 so it runs front to back.
Assumed stack, bottom to top: wheel holders p32/p33, bricks p4/p5 (hanging under p12), plate p12, base p19. Wedge p23 sits on the front of p12, and the hood p21 and hinge plate p20 sit on the wedge.

p4/p5 are listed as resting on p32/p33 (all added in step 8). They also clutch the underside of p12, which was added in step 1. That link is in other_joins because rests_on only allows earlier pieces.
The positions of grille tiles, red plates, clips, bar p16, cone, shovel and jackhammer are guesses from small pictures.
The minifigure shown in the booklet is not in the piece list, so it is not included.
Steps 9 and 10 repeat the step 8 pictures with the model turned. Wheels, cone, shovel and jackhammer are assumed to be added in step 11.
